newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac, African leaders pay last honour to Foccart.
newsitem.headline: Chirac, African leaders pay last honour to Foccart.

text.p: President Jacques Chirac and eight African heads of state and government paid a last hommage to veteran French Africa kingmaker Jacques Foccart at a military funeral on Monday.
A former spymaster and African affairs adviser to three French presidents, who made and broke governments in former French West African colonies, Foccart died last Wednesday aged 83.
He was a close aide to general Charles de Gaulle from World War Two until his death in 1970 and remained an honorary adviser to Chirac until recent weeks.

Foccart was given military honours in the courtyard of Les Invalides military hospital in Paris, near the chapel where the emperor Napoleon is buried, before being buried in a family tomb at Luzarche, north of Paris.
